authority_separation.supervisory_mems: May request schedules/transitions but cannot independently authorize switchgear or protection operations.
authority_separation.local_controller: Executes permitted local sequencing under fresh observations and hard interlocks.
authority_separation.independent_protection: Owns protection trips and independent synchronism/close permissives.
authority_separation.operator: May request or acknowledge operations; does not override interlocks or independent protection.
authority_separation.maintenance_authority: May authorize maintenance/inspection workflow; does not bypass independent protection.

guards.predicate: Grid quality is inside the declared site/product envelope.
Required telemetry is fresh, time-aligned and quality-qualified.
Independent protection/interlocks report ready; no bypass or trip is active.
A qualified grid-forming resource is available for the intended island.
Qualified source/storage capability meets the declared reserve obligation.
Independent breaker feedback confirms the PCC is physically open.
Grid-loss criterion is detected from qualified local measurements.
Independent synchronism check confirms voltage/frequency/phase permissives.
Grid-forming source established stable bus voltage and frequency.
Authorized black-start permit and dead-bus preconditions are satisfied.
Start sequence failed or reached the declared timeout.
Independent protection reports a trip/interlock condition.
Authorized inspection and isolation reconciliation are complete.
Protection owner independently verifies the trip is cleared; no software reset is assumed.
Breaker, source, topology and protection states reconcile to independent observations.
Close permissive is active at the independent protection/synchronism boundary.
Supervisory communication/telemetry freshness crossed its declared timeout.
Island bus remains inside declared voltage/frequency and service limits.
Supervisory MEMS is not an independent switchgear/protection authority.
No active protection lockout or interlock blocks the proposed operation.

transitions.failure_disposition: Remain grid-connected; reject preparation if any guard is unknown.
Hold safe mode; command acknowledgement is not proof of breaker effect.
Independent protection/local control follows its approved action; supervisory policy cannot veto.
Remain islanded; no close command is issued.
Remain open and islanded; require fresh independent synchronism permissive.
Remain de-energized; no automatic repeated start.
Abort to safe dead-bus hold if stable formation is not verified.
Stay in safe hold; retry requires a new authorized procedure.
Protection operates locally; supervisory system cannot inhibit or reset it.
Remain tripped until physical state and authorization are reconciled.
Enter bounded local fallback; unresolved physical state blocks new mutation.
Maintain local island control/protection; reconcile before supervisory mutations.
Remain in unknown hold; no close or control mutation.
Remain in unknown hold; no mutation until physical state reconciles.
Reject request; no physical operation or state promotion.
transitions.forbidden_reason: Supervisory MEMS is not switchgear/protection authority.

transitions.failure_disposition: Reject close; remain islanded until independent sync-check passes.
Reject reset/close request; protection remains tripped.
transitions.forbidden_reason: Protection lockout cannot be bypassed by operator or supervisory policy.
